dedupe_keys.name: fault simulation dataset for 110 kv power transmission lines

description: Fault Simulation Dataset for 110 kV Power Transmission Lines is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Živko Sokolović (Elektrotehnicki Institut Nikola Tesla). This dataset contains simulated fault events for fault detection, classification, and localization in 110 kV power transmission lines. The simulations were conducted using DIgSILENT PowerFactory, with a Python script automating fault generation, data extraction, and dataset compilation. The simulations include three fault types: single-phase-to-ground fault (spgf), two-phase short circuit (2psc), and three-phase short circuit (3psc). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
